@@U01072@@
(Enter 梅菲斯特.)

@@U01073@@
Listen, I want you to get me that girl!

@@U01075@@
Girl? Which girl?

@@U01077@@
She just passed by.

@@U01079@@
Oh, her! Yes, well, I mean, she’s just come from confession, you know. The priest absolved her of her sins, every last one, no less. I crept up close to hear and, well— she’s an innocent, a young thing with nothing to confess. How could I have power over her?

@@U01081@@
She’s over fourteen, isn’t she?

@@U01083@@
Ah! There! The down-and-dirty libertine speaks! Your kind believes every blossom blows for him alone; you flatter yourself that there’s no honor or favor that isn’t yours for the reaping. It’s just that things don’t always fall out that way.

@@U01085@@
I suggest to you, Most Mighty Master Moralist, that you come down off your pulpit and spare me your sermons. And let me be brief and to the point. Either that sweet lovely thing is in my arms tonight, or at midnight you and I are quits.
translation:
@@U01072@@
（梅菲斯特上。）

@@U01073@@
听着，我要你给我找那个女孩！

@@U01075@@
女孩？哪个女孩？

@@U01077@@
她刚刚路过。

@@U01079@@
哦，她！是的，嗯，我的意思是，她刚刚坦白，你知道。神父赦免了她的所有罪孽，不少于一罪。我蹑手蹑脚地走近去听，嗯——她是个天真无邪的年轻人，没什么可坦白的。我怎么可能对她有权力？

@@U01081@@
她已经十四岁了，不是吗？

@@U01083@@
啊！那里！下流的浪荡子居然敢说话！你们相信每一朵花都为他而绽放；你自以为没有什么荣誉或恩惠不是你可以收获的。只是事情并不总是那样。

@@U01085@@
我建议你，最强大的道德大师，从讲坛上下来，别再给我讲道了。让我简明扼要地讲一下。要么今晚那个甜蜜可爱的东西在我怀里，要么在午夜你和我分手。
